annotation.title_clean: Council Directive 70/156/EEC of 6 February 1970 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Council Directive 70/156/EEC of 6 February 1970 on the approximation of the laws of the Member States relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 042
annotation.summary_en: 1970 Council Directive establishing EEC type-approval for motor vehicles and trailers, with mutual recognition among Member States, certificates of conformity, production conformity checks and a technical progress committee. Foundational for the EU vehicle type-approval framework; it contains no AI or automation provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Creates EEC type-approval procedure for motor vehicle types, with manufacturer applications to one Member State
Vehicles with a certificate of conformity cannot be refused registration or sale by other Member States
Member States may temporarily ban vehicles posing road safety hazards for up to six months
Sets up a Committee on Adaptation to Technical Progress to update technical requirements
Annexes give model information document, type-approval certificate and certificate of conformity
